group.label: Memoirs · The Shadow That Signals Victory

lines.text: We were back out on the battlefield today. There were a lot more Raptures than usual. One by one, my comrades fell, and eventually I ran out of ammo... It was around that point that I figured I was going to die too.

But then, just as the Raptures were closing in on where I was hiding, a massive shadow passed by. I looked up and saw a gigantic ship. It opened fire, and the sound of explosions filled the air. Tons of Raptures heard it and rushed in the direction it was headed.
I still have no idea what that ship was or who was on it. At the time, I was just grateful to be alive.
